schema.rows: [occurrences, totalP50Ms, totalP95Ms, exclusiveSelfP50Ms|null, exclusiveSelfP95Ms|null, exclusiveSelfWithheld] — exclusive self is reported only where every occurrence could be priced; a null pair with a non-zero withheld count is the documented case, never a missing number
schema.marks: mark name -> rows, over the class's measured accepted actions (leading five warm-up actions excluded, accepted outcomes only). `marks` is POSITIONAL against `markNames`: entry i of a class's `marks` is that name's rows, or null when the mark never fired for that class.
schema.boundaries: the action's own measured boundaries -> rows
schema.unattributedOutsideActions: [occurrences, p50Ms, p95Ms, totalMs] per mark name observed outside every action span — the explicit remainder, never attributed to an action (names above 1 ms only; the remaining names are pooled in `unattributedOmittedMs`)
schema.nesting: indices into `nestingPairs` (parent > child) as observed inside one representative accepted action; the release family only
schema.marksOmitted: mark names deliberately not projected into this record: the harness's own undo/restore path (p2311:restore-* and p2311:baseline-restore) and the commit-matches/commit-replace/standalone-wall-build controls. They exist in the live harness record; none is part of the wall-chain release split
schema.rounding: all ms values rounded to 2 decimals; nothing here may be summed across nested nodes

protocol: P23B.11 S1/S7 wall-chain browser profile; action-class sessions on the S6 protocol (settled, zero dropped boundaries), paths wall-authoring and room-creation-commit, fixtures straight-40 · all-curved-40 · owner-40-curved · connected-curved-grid-v1 (advisory); no baseline and no ratchet is read or written
